title: Form definition
description: A multi-step form as a UCM-shaped schema: properties are UCM properties, steps are structure.layout entries of type step. Stored as UCF content of the form-definition model, or as the plain object in `fields`.

version.description: Raised on every publish; saved drafts record it and are checked against it on resume

resetDrafts.description: Raise to make saved drafts start over (when old answers no longer make sense)

hidden.description: Left out unless a rule includes it

slots.description: Places where patch fields may land

type.description: content: a text block with no value (never submitted); file: uploads, whose value is [{ name, size, type }] and which are never saved in a draft

kind.description: The field type from an installed type package (types/core.json, dk/cpr, …) the field was made from; tells an editor which settings to show. Optional: typeOf() infers it from type and ui.widget

content.description: Text block only: the text, plain; a blank line starts a new paragraph

from.description: Prefill from context.* or facts.* while the field has no answer (for example a hidden campaign value)

consent.description: Consent fields (ui.widget consent) only: the wording and the notice it refers to, recorded with the answer

track.description: Choice fields with privacy none only: the chosen value may be sent to analytics

privacy.description: none: may be saved anywhere; personal: saved in drafts the person chose to keep; special (health, national id, …): never saved in a draft. Form fields default to none, patch fields to personal

accept.description: File fields: allowed types, as the accept attribute (.pdf,image/*)

maxSize.description: File fields: largest file in bytes

maxFiles.description: File fields: how many files (1 by default)

check.description: Names of host functions (evaluate input.functions) that check the value: null passes, { code, message, level? } fails

messages.description: Message per issue code (minimum, pattern, dk-cpr, …), replacing the default

widget.description: email, tel, url, date, time, textarea, radio, consent, hidden, …

hidden.description: Hidden unless a rule shows it
